items.name: Acid
items.desc: The corrosive spray of a black dragon's breath and the dissolving enzymes secreted by a black pudding deal acid damage.

items.name: Bludgeoning
items.desc: Blunt force attacks, falling, constriction, and the like deal bludgeoning damage.

items.name: Cold
items.desc: The infernal chill radiating from an ice devil's spear and the frigid blast of a white dragon's breath deal cold damage.

items.name: Fire
items.desc: Red dragons breathe fire, and many spells conjure flames to deal fire damage.

items.name: Force
items.desc: Force is pure magical energy focused into a damaging form. Most effects that deal force damage are spells, including magic missile and spiritual weapon.

items.name: Lightning
items.desc: A lightning bolt spell and a blue dragon's breath deal lightning damage.

items.name: Necrotic
items.desc: Necrotic damage, dealt by certain undead and a spell such as chill touch, withers matter and even the soul.

items.name: Piercing
items.desc: Puncturing and impaling attacks, including spears and monsters' bites, deal piercing damage.

items.name: Poison
items.desc: Venomous stings and the toxic gas of a green dragon's breath deal poison damage.

items.name: Psychic
items.desc: Mental abilities such as a psionic blast deal psychic damage.

items.name: Radiant
items.desc: Radiant damage, dealt by a cleric's flame strike spell or an angel's smiting weapon, sears the flesh like fire and overloads the spirit with power.

items.name: Slashing
items.desc: Swords, axes, and monsters' claws deal slashing damage.

items.name: Thunder
items.desc: A concussive burst of sound, such as the effect of the thunderwave spell, deals thunder damage.
